what: The section is pinned, and while scrolling by the width of the panel row, the text panels flow left in a straight line without curves (each panel xPercent −100×number of panels). The same range is divided by the panel count, so on each turn that panel becomes is-active and the full-bleed photo behind it is uncovered from the right with clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0), revealing the next photo (the last photo stays). Below 767px the panels stack vertically and only the back photo panel is pinned and wipes upward

options.narrow: Width for switching to portrait (px), default 767
